sections.title: Chapel & Worship
sections.subtitle: Growing Together in Faith
sections.description: Regular chapel services and times of worship provide opportunities for students, faculty, and staff to grow spiritually through prayer, biblical teaching, and fellowship.

sections.title: Campus Life
sections.subtitle: Learning Beyond the Classroom
sections.description: Campus life encourages students to build meaningful relationships through fellowship, academic collaboration, and participation in various campus activities.

sections.title: Library & Learning Resources
sections.subtitle: Supporting Academic Study
sections.description: The library provides students with access to theological resources, reference materials, and study spaces that support learning and academic research.

sections.title: Music & Worship Ministry
sections.subtitle: Developing Musical Gifts
sections.description: Students interested in music and worship have opportunities to develop their skills through practical learning, rehearsals, and participation in worship services and special programs.

sections.title: Student Activities
sections.subtitle: Building Community
sections.description: Throughout the academic year, students participate in campus events, fellowship gatherings, sports activities, and other programs that encourage teamwork and personal growth.

sections.title: Community & Student Support
sections.subtitle: A Caring Learning Environment
sections.description: Glory Education Center seeks to provide a welcoming environment where students receive academic encouragement, spiritual guidance, and opportunities to grow in community.
